verdicts.reason: Source task306_t321 directly uses GitLab's /api/v4/projects/{id}/repository/commits endpoint with since/until and reads JSON payload plus pagination headers. The method returns typed commit records and pagination metadata, and correctly leaves author-specific filtering/counting outside the primitive.

Source task350_t298 fetches /-/project_members, extracts the data-members-data attribute, HTML-unescapes it, JSON-decodes it, and reads members from data['user']['members']. The method matches that site-specific acquisition/parsing and returns typed member fields while excluding the task-specific self-exclusion logic.

Source task350_t298 queries /dashboard/projects with name, personal=true, and sort=name_asc, then parses project links for the target personal namespace. The method preserves that reusable dashboard search/list parsing pattern, returns typed project records, and does not claim task-level selection among matches.

Source task317_t324 navigates to /{namespace}/{project}/-/graphs/{branch}, reads main page text, and regex-parses contributor names and commit counts from the visible ranking. The method is a faithful typed generalization that removes only the task's top-3/answer-formatting logic.

Source task172_t289 opens /dashboard/projects, clicks the Personal filter, iterates main .projects-list > li rows, identifies the project link, and parses four visible counts from row text. The method returns those typed per-project stats for all rows and properly leaves zero-star filtering outside the primitive.

Source task172_t289 opens each project page and parses visible Project ID and Star count from body text. The method returns a typed project record with those two fields and correctly omits the workflow's task-specific selection/filtering/aggregation decisions.

Source task175_t310 searches dashboard issue lists for both author_username and assignee_username views, extracts issue links, matches titles containing a substring, and follows next-page links. The method captures that reusable site acquisition pattern, returns typed issue link records, and leaves final answer choice/state interpretation to other logic.

Source task175_t310 opens an issue URL, reads body text and page title, and determines open versus closed from visible Open/Close issue and Closed/Reopen issue signals. The method returns typed state fields and does not include the workflow's task-specific boolean answer wrapper.
